title: spec/i18n: a joined report's block labels have no translation key, so under zh-CN the showcase's "Task Overview" shows a translated title above English block headings ("Open Tasks", "Completed Tasks")
body:
Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named location and a named real producer. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01HbmCEPMBmMLU3VZCEzfec7`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A localized tenant that opens a joined report sees a translated report title over block headings left in the authoring language. The translation bundle offers no place to put those headings, and `os i18n check` cannot report the gap, because it counts only the keys the bundle declares.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:spec` seat: the `reports` translation group in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and its resolver, then the console renderer.

## Measured (reading of `main` `0a694821`; not run in a browser)

- #25788 (landed as #25826) made a report translatable at `reports.<report_name>.label` / `.description` only.
- A joined report's block declares a `label` and a `description` (`packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`: `label: I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, "Human label shown above the block"). The renderer prints it at `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` (`resolveText(block.label, …)` in the joined branch).
- reach, a named real producer: `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/reports/index.ts` `showcase_task_overview` declares blocks `open_block` ("Open Tasks") and `done_block` ("Completed Tasks"). The showcase's zh-CN bundle (`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`) translates the report itself (「任务概览（联合）」) and has no slot for either block.
- An inline locale map on `label` (`{ en, 'zh-CN' }`) works today. But it is the second of two conventions (`i18n.zod.ts`), and the bundle is the one the coverage gate reads.

## Expected

- The bundle declares `reports.<report_name>.blocks.<block_name>.label` / `.description` (shape is the seat's to settle), the resolver applies it, and the joined renderer shows it.
- `os i18n extract` / `check` count the block keys the way #25788 made them count the report's.
- A pin: the showcase's joined report renders both block headings translated under zh-CN.

## Source

The independent review of PR #25826 (item ③.3, comment `6400225090`) called this "should be a card, not a blocker". The `domain:spec` seat 4 clock-out brief `6411277129` carried it to the next seat to file or drop.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` (objectstack, open and closed) for "joined report block label translation key bundle": 9 hits, all closed. Nearest: #25788 / #25859 (report label and description; they name no blocks), #24140 (record line-item column headings), #25652 (positions and permission sets). Control: #25788 is the expected hit and was returned. No card covers block labels.
